test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: All sixty students of a class appeared in a mathematics examination. 25 students scored 96 average marks. The remaining students got 84 average marks. The average marks of the entire class is _______.
solution:
Given:

The average marks of 25 students = 96

The average marks of the remaining students = 84

Total students = 60

Concept used:

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

Calculation:

Let the average of the entire class be x.

⇒ 60x = 25 × 96 + 35 × 84

⇒ 60x = 2400 + 2940

⇒ 60x = 5340

⇒ x = 5340/60 = 89

**The average mark of the entire class is 89.**
